stories.title: The Little Bookshop
stories.content:
It was a rainy afternoon. Lily walked into a small bookshop near the park. The room was warm, and the shelves were full of books.
An old man smiled at her. “Are you looking for a story?” he asked. Lily nodded. He gave her a book with a blue cover.
She sat by the window and began to read. Outside, the rain grew quiet. Inside, Lily found a new world.
stories.content_cn:
那是一个下雨的午后。莉莉走进了公园附近的一家小书店。屋子里很温暖，书架上摆满了书。
一位老人向她微笑。“你在找故事吗？”他问道。莉莉点了点头。他递给她一本蓝色封面的书。
她坐在窗边，开始阅读。窗外的雨渐渐变小了。屋子里，莉莉发现了一个新的世界。
